crossRefs.note: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught…

translations.web: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
translations.bsb: And early in the morning all the people would come to hear Him at the temple.
translations.kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
translations.asv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, to hear him.
